delivery.title: Imininingwane Yokulethwa - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Ukudlula" lapha kusho kuphela ukuthi iseva eqondiwe ibuyise isimo se HTTP 2xx - ayiqinisekisi isistimu eyamukelayo egcinwe noma icutshungulwe ukuhola. Hlola indikimba yempendulo ngenhla ukuthi ithini ngempela; uma ingenalutho noma iwukuvuma nje, leyo sistimu ingase ithole isicelo kodwa yenqabe noma izibe ukukhokhelwa ngaphakathi (amagama enkambu engalungile/ifomethi ye API yayo , inkambu edingekayo ohlangothini lwayo okungafaki lokhu kulayisha, njll).

push.title: Webhooks Aphumayo - Ama-Push Lead & Updates
push.intro: Enziwa ngendlela oyifisayo ngokugcwele webhook ngayinye : JSON , Ifomu (x-www-form-urlencoded), noma isifanekiso sakho Seziko Lomzimba esinezimeli <fieldkey></fieldkey> (isb <example></example> ) - isebenza njengokugcwalisa umyalo cURL kanye.
push.curlHelp: Namathisela isibonelo ucele amadokhumenti abo API noma Postman akunikeza (ngedatha yangempela noma eyisampula). URL , indlela kanye nezihloko zikopishwa njengoba zinjalo, futhi wonke ukhiye osemzimbeni ufakwe ohlwini ngezansi ukuze ukwazi ukukhetha ukuthi iyiphi inkambu CRM eyigcwalisa ngomthofu ngamunye.
push.curlPrompt: Unayo i- cURL yeklayenti? <action>Ngenisa kusuka cURL</action> ukuze ugcwalise lokhu futhi izinkambu zemephu ngokuzenzakalelayo.
push.urlVariables: I URL ingaba nezinto eziguquguqukayo futhi, isb <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Izihloko kufanele zibe JSON evumelekile , isb {{example}}
push.authTitle: Ukuqinisekisa (indlela Leadrat engena ngayo ku API yayo)
push.modeSame: Thumela wonke umcimbi ku- URL efanayo
push.modeCreateUpdate: Dala irekhodi kanye, bese ubuyekeza lelo rekhodi (azikho izimpinda ohlangothini lwazo)
push.responseIdHint: Lapho i ID ikumpendulo yabo JSON esicelweni sokudala. Kulondolozwe ngokuhola ngakunye njengokuthi <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Ngokuvala isikhathi, amaphutha HTTP 429 kanye ne-5xx - ngemva kweminithi elingu-1, amaminithi angu-5, amaminithi angu-30, 2 h, 6 h.
push.howFilled: Amanani agcwaliswa kanjani: le webhook iphinda isetshenziswe kuwo wonke umthofu - Leadrat ayithumeli isibonelo esimile, ithumela ukucindezela okusha njalo lapho kwenzeka umcimbi okhethiwe, ngamavelu amanje aKHONA.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Ifomu ifaka ngokuzenzakalela yonke inkambu ekuholeni - akukho okuzosethwa.
push.howFilledCustom: Ngokwezifiso - bhala eyakho inhlangano yesicelo bese uphonsa noma yikuphi; ngayinye ishintshiwe ngenani langempela lalowo mthofu ngaphambi kokuyithumela. Chofoza okuhlukile ngezansi ukuze ukufake.

receive.intro: Umthombo ngamunye uthola URL yawo . Khomba izikhangiso eziholayo ze Facebook , Zapier , ifomu lewebhusayithi noma enye webhook ye- CRM kuyo - bathumela umkhondo ngefomethi yabo JSON noma yefomu, futhi ubeka imephu izinkambu zabo kwezakho.

pull.intro: Leadrat ibiza API yolunye uhlelo kushejuli (noma iyiphi i-auth, noma yikuphi ukupheja) futhi ingenisa amarekhodi ewabuyiselayo. Amarekhodi ewabonile ngaphambi kokuvuselela ukuhola okufanayo.

api.title: API Yakho - Ukufinyelela Kwezindlela Ezimbili Kwanoma Iyiphi Isistimu
api.intro: Noma iyiphi isistimu enokhiye wakho API ingadala, ifunde futhi ibuyekeze imikhondo futhi ibhalisele ukuhola imicimbi. Thumela ukhiye kunhlokweni <hdr></hdr> , njengo- <bearer></bearer> , noma (uma ithuluzi lingakwazi ukusetha izihloko) njenge- <query></query> . Umkhawulo: {{limit}} izicelo ngomzuzu.
api.noPermission: Othile kuphela onemvume yokuphatha izilungiselelo ongabuka ukhiye API .
api.shownOnce: Kopisha lo khiye manje futhi uwugcine endaweni ethile ephephile - ukuze uvikeleke uboniswa kanye kuphela. Uma ilahlekile, yenza entsha.
api.regenerateConfirm: Khiqiza ukhiye omusha API ? Ukhiye wamanje uyeka ukusebenza ngokushesha kuwo wonke amasistimu ayisebenzisayo.
api.openApiHint: Ngenisa i OpenAPI spec ku- Postman , Zapier , Make noma n8n ukuze uthole yonke indawo elungele ukusetshenziswa.
